questions.q: What symmetry gives rise to charge conservation?
questions.explanation: U(1) gauge symmetry — the freedom to rotate the phase of a quantum field — leads to charge conservation via Noether's theorem.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT a known property of electric charge?
options: It can be destroyed in a vacuum
It is conserved in isolated systems
questions.explanation: Charge cannot be created or destroyed. Conservation of charge has been verified to 1 part in 10²¹.

questions.q: How many elementary charges make up one coulomb?
questions.explanation: One coulomb = approximately 6.24 × 10¹⁸ elementary charges (each of magnitude 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C).
